added_lines: remembrance tree : as a way of remembering deceased loved ones, we invite you to write the names of loved ones who have passed away on a label and place it on the remembrance tree in ballinamore church. please sit and pray for a while. visitation of the sick and housebound : fr seán will be in contact prior to his visiting the sick and housebound: corraleehan and aughawillan on wednesday morning 4th november, aughnasheelin on thursday morning 5th november and ballinamore on thursday afternoon. bereavement mass : our annual mass of consolation for those bereaved in the past 12 months, will take place in st. mary’s church, aughnasheelin, on friday 20th november at 8pm . annual mass : for deceased members and staff of leitrim county council will be held in st. marys church, carrick on shannon, on monday 2nd of november 2026 at 8pm. care of creation agm: the 2026 annual general meeting of kilmore care of creation will be held on thursday the 19th november at 7pm in the conaty centre/pastoral centre, cavan town, co cavan, h12 e5c7. diocesan pilgrimage to assisi : there are still a number of places available on this pilgrimage which takes place from tuesday 24th to sunday 29th november 2026 to mark the 800th anniversary of the death of st francis of assisi. bishop martin hayes will lead the pilgrimage and fr seán kelly ofm cap. wil l be the spiritual director. anyone wishing to participate in the pilgrimage should contact marian pilgrimages directly a nd as soon as possible on (01) 878 8159 as places are limited, especially for those seeking single room accommodation.
